issues.explanation: No new Pest tests ship with the new actions, policy, model, or migration; only existing CallNextTicketTest setup lines were added.
issues.location: tests/ (no new test files in diff; cf. tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php:629)

issues.explanation: Any SQLSTATE 23000 (including FK or NOT NULL violations) is reported as slug-taken, which can mislabel non-uniqueness DB errors.
When the name slugifies to empty, CreateQueue can persist an empty slug while UpdateQueue keeps the old slug instead; behavior is inconsistent and unvalidated.
Identical isUniqueViolation helper is copy-pasted into CreateQueue and UpdateQueue instead of being shared, and UpdateQueue wraps a single save in a DB transaction.
New public action methods ship without PHPDoc despite the docs convention to document touched public methods.
Policy hardcodes the 'call' string instead of reusing QueuePermission::Call->value, duplicating the permission name.

conventions.evidence: Actions for domain writes, Gate/policy authorization, #[Fillable] on QueueAccess matching Ticket style, reversible migration with down(), docs plus CHANGELOG updated. Deviation: zero new Pest tests despite TDD rule (No production code without a test); no PHPDoc on new public actions.

readability.evidence: Clear names, small focused methods, sibling-consistent style (app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:58-89; app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:456-503). Nits: missing docblocks on new actions; Ticket.php may retain a now-unused EntityMembership import after app/Models/Ticket.php:423-426 removal.

requirements.evidence: CreateQueue app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:58-89 (trim/1-255, slug default/slugify, active, pre-check plus race catch); UpdateQueue app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:225-296 (nullable params, own-slug allowed, race catch); SetQueueAccess app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:134-203 (same-entity check, allowlist, upsert/revoke, audit with actor_id/queue_id/entity_membership_id, no log when no row); QueuePolicy app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:456-503 (create/update/manageAccess/call incl. non-array deny); call paths app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:31-33 and app/Models/Ticket.php:419-435 (inactive then authorize then LogicException). Gaps: empty-slug fallback; wholesale 23000 mapping.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task: actions, enum, model, policy, migration, factory, both call-path guards, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md Added entry, CallNextTicketTest owner-setup lines. No delete action, no UI, no unrelated refactors.

security.evidence: Gate authorize is the first statement in all three actions; call is enforced after lock plus active check in both paths and throws AuthorizationException (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:31-33; app/Models/Ticket.php:427-429); name/slug/permission/same-entity inputs validated; corrupted non-array permissions deny (app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:498-500). No weakness found in shown code.

simplicity.evidence: Lean and direct, reuses Gate, Str::slug, policy, updateOrCreate. Some duplication: identical isUniqueViolation in both queue actions; DB::transaction around a single save (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:282-285); literal 'call' instead of the enum value.

tests.evidence: No new test files in diff; only added owner-membership setup lines in tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php:629,637,645,653,661,669,677,685,693,701,709,717,725,733 to keep the suite green under new auth. No coverage for Create/Update/SetQueueAccess, policy call matrix, validation, race, or audit paths.

review.summary: The change implements the full queue lifecycle, per-queue access grants with audit logging, and call authorization on both paths with correct ordering. The code itself is clean and convention-following, but it ships with zero new tests, has minor edge-case imprecisions, and the diff is truncated mid-hunk so confidence is low; it needs substantial rework (a test suite) before merging.
